============
Utility Apps
============

the following utility applications are provided to assist with the operation of the daoEkarus system.

- `closeLoop.py`_
- `daoEkarusCreateShm.py`_
- `daoEkarusSendCommand.py`_
- `daoEkarusServer.py`_
- `daoEkarusStartCblueAqusition.py`_
- `daoEkarusStartOcamAcqusition.py`_
- `daoEkarusStopCblueAcqusition.py`_
- `daoEkarusStopOcamAcqusition.py`_
- `FilterTTFromFlat.py`_
- `loadFlat.py`_
- `moveFastTTCircle.py`_
- `moveFastTT.py`_
- `openLoop.py`_
- `relaxFastTT.py`_
- `resetFlat.py`_
- `saveFlat.py`_
- `select_valid_pixels.py`_
- `setLoopGain.py`_
- `setLoopLeak.py`_
- `setModulation.py`_
- `setOcamFps.py`_
- `setOcamGain.py`_
- `setOcamTemp.py`_
- `takeBG.py`_
- `updateOcamValuesInGUI.py`_

closeLoop.py
------------
closeLoop.py is a utility application that closes the control loop of the daoEkarus system

daoEkarusCreateShm.py
---------------------
daoEkarusCreateShm.py is a utility application that creates the shared memory segments for the daoEkarus system.

daoEkarusSendCommand.py
-------------------------
daoEkarusSendCommand.py is a utility application that sends commands to the daoEkarus system.

daoEkarusServer.py
-------------------
daoEkarusServer.py is a utility application that runs the remote server for the daoEkarus system.

daoEkarusStartCblueAqusition.py
--------------------------------
daoEkarusStartCblueAqusition.py is a utility application that starts the Cblue acquisition component of the daoEkarus system.

daoEkarusStartOcamAcqusition.py
--------------------------------
daoEkarusStartOcamAcqusition.py is a utility application that starts the Ocam acquisition component of the daoEkarus system.

daoEkarusStopCblueAcqusition.py
--------------------------------
daoEkarusStopCblueAcqusition.py is a utility application that stops the Cblue acquisition component of the daoEkarus system.

daoEkarusStopOcamAcqusition.py
-------------------------------
daoEkarusStopOcamAcqusition.py is a utility application that stops the Ocam acquisition component of the daoEkarus system.

FilterTTFromFlat.py
-------------------
FilterTTFromFlat.py is a utility application that filters the TT data from the flat field images.

loadFlat.py
------------
loadFlat.py is a utility application that loads the flat field images.

moveFastTTCircle.py
--------------------
moveFastTTCircle.py is a utility application that moves the fast TT circle.

moveFastTT.py
--------------
moveFastTT.py is a utility application that moves the fast TT.

openLoop.py
------------
openLoop.py is a utility application that opens the control loop of the daoEkarus system.

relaxFastTT.py
--------------
relaxFastTT.py is a utility application that mitigates the hysteresis of the fast TT mirror

resetFlat.py
-------------
resetFlat.py is a utility application that resets the flat field images.

saveFlat.py
------------
saveFlat.py is a utility application that saves the flat field images.

select_valid_pixels.py
-----------------------
select_valid_pixels.py is a utility application that selects valid pixels from the flat field images.

setLoopGain.py
---------------
setLoopGain.py is a utility application that sets the gain of the control loop.

setLoopLeak.py
---------------
setLoopLeak.py is a utility application that sets the leak of the control loop.

setModulation.py
-----------------
setModulation.py is a utility application that sets the modulation of the daoEkarus system.

setOcamFps.py
--------------
setOcamFps.py is a utility application that sets the frames per second of the Ocam camera.

setOcamGain.py
---------------
setOcamGain.py is a utility application that sets the gain of the Ocam camera.

setOcamTemp.py
---------------
setOcamTemp.py is a utility application that sets the temperature of the Ocam camera.

takeBG.py
----------
takeBG.py is a utility application that takes background images.

updateOcamValuesInGUI.py
-------------------------
updateOcamValuesInGUI.py is a utility application that updates the Ocam values in the GUI.
